items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1961-07-02
items.q: I try to get him away until he comes. ... You see him again, tell him we haven't forgotten him.

ctx.x: There's one man we were just thinking about when we drove up here. He has a garage over here, uh, Baby Bruce, they call it. His real name is Bruce.
Bruce, I'm trying to get Bruce, Bruce to his, not all of them. I try to get him away until he comes.

We were over and interviewed him and we told him that sometime we'd like to record him on the piano, maybe up to Tulane or someplace, because he's never made any records. Yeah. He tried a couple, you know that old beat up piano he has in his place over there? Yeah, he's been on that one.
